mapper.sql: i.id, i.batch_id, i.building, i.room_no, i.leader_student_id, i.check_date, i.inspector_id, i.item_json, i.score, i.grade, i.problems, i.rectify_required, i.rectify_deadline, i.rectify_status, i.rectify_note, i.rectify_at, i.recheck_by, i.recheck_at, i.recheck_result, i.source, i.created_at, i.updated_at, i.deleted, b.batch_name AS batch_name, b.term AS term, b.status AS batch_status, COALESCE(NULLIF(ins.real_name, ''), ins.nickname, ins.username) AS inspector_name
FROM community_inspection i INNER JOIN community_batch b ON b.id = i.batch_id AND b.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users ins ON ins.id = i.inspector_id

sql.if: AND (i.building LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.room_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.problems LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_inspection (batch_id, building, room_no, leader_student_id, check_date, inspector_id, item_json, score, grade, problems, rectify_required, rectify_deadline, rectify_status, rectify_note, rectify_at, recheck_by, recheck_at, recheck_result, source, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{building}, #{roomNo}, #{leaderStudentId}, #{checkDate}, #{inspectorId}, #{itemJson}, #{score}, #{grade}, #{problems}, #{rectifyRequired}, #{rectifyDeadline}, #{rectifyStatus}, #{rectifyNote}, #{rectifyAt}, #{recheckBy}, #{recheckAt}, #{recheckResult}, #{source}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE i.batch_id = #{batchId} AND i.building = #{building} AND i.room_no = #{roomNo} AND i.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE community_inspection SET rectify_status = 'submitted', rectify_note = #{note}, rectify_at = #{at}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND rectify_status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE community_inspection SET rectify_status = #{toStatus}, recheck_result = #{result}, recheck_by = #{by}, recheck_at = #{at}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND rectify_status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE community_inspection i INNER JOIN community_batch b ON b.id = i.batch_id SET i.deleted = 1, i.updated_at = NOW() WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.deleted = 0 AND b.status IN ('checking', 'scored')
mapper.select:
SELECT i.grade AS grade, COUNT(*) AS total
WHERE i.deleted = 0
GROUP BY i.grade ORDER BY i.grade

SELECT i.rectify_status AS rectify_status, COUNT(*) AS total
WHERE i.deleted = 0
GROUP BY i.rectify_status ORDER BY i.rectify_status

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(i.score), 2) AS avg_score, MIN(i.score) AS min_score, MAX(i.score) AS max_score, SUM(CASE WHEN i.grade = 'excellent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excellent, SUM(CASE WHEN i.grade = 'good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good, SUM(CASE WHEN i.grade = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass, SUM(CASE WHEN i.grade = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail, SUM(CASE WHEN i.rectify_status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rectify_pending, SUM(CASE WHEN i.rectify_status = 'submitted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rectify_submitted, SUM(CASE WHEN i.rectify_status = 'accepted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rectify_accepted, SUM(CASE WHEN i.rectify_status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rectify_rejected
WHERE i.deleted = 0
SELECT p.user_id FROM student_profile p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.dorm_building = #{building} AND p.dorm_room = #{roomNo} ORDER BY p.id ASC LIMIT 1
